name: Skulker
desc: Requires Dexterity 13+. +1 Dexterity. Blindsight 10 feet. Fog of War: you have Advantage on the Dexterity (Stealth) check you make as part of the Hide action. Sniper: if you make an attack roll while hidden and it misses, making the attack doesn't reveal your location.

effects.note: Hide action: Advantage on the Stealth check; a missed attack while hidden doesn't reveal you
